attributes.name: [Elastic Cloud] Successful sign-in after repeated failures
attributes.description: An identity fails at least 5 times and then authenticates in the same 30 minutes.

investigation_guide.blob:
## Successful sign-in after repeated failures

The identity failed at least 5 times and then authenticated, with the success after the first failure.

### Triage
1. Confirm the success source on **[Audit] Identity & Access**.
2. A person mistyping a password and then succeeding can match. Check the failure count and the source IP.

### Tuning
Raise the failure count from 5 to ignore ordinary mistypes.

esqlQuery.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("authentication_failed", "authentication_success")
| WHERE authentication.type IS NULL OR authentication.type != "internal"
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name)
| WHERE actor IS NOT NULL
| EVAL actor_kind = CASE(user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", "cloud_api_key", user.email IS NOT NULL, "user", api_key.name IS NOT NULL OR authentication.type == "api_key", "api_key", "principal")
| WHERE actor NOT IN ("elastic.maintenance", "autoscaling", "elasticsearch-controller", "elastic/fleet-server", "elastic/kibana")
| STATS failures = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "authentication_failed", successes = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "authentication_success", first_failure = MIN(@timestamp) WHERE event.action == "authentication_failed", last_success = MAX(@timestamp) WHERE event.action == "authentication_success" BY actor, actor_kind
| WHERE failures >= 5 AND successes >= 1 AND last_success > first_failure
| SORT failures DESC
| LIMIT 100
